scene: The bowing masked artisan presents travel tokens for three waiting transit lines.
picture: Flat side view across the pavilion transit hub. Far left, a streamlined lacquered bento bullet train sits by the water. Left, the grandfather stands holding his bicycle. Centre, a moss-draped garden tram waits with doors open, beside the bowing owl artisan. Right, painted fans dry on stands. Far right, a red-and-cream streetcar idles.
shown: a sleek lacquered train carriage waiting at the canal platform on far left
a moss-roofed tram with open brass doors standing at the centre
a clanging red-and-cream streetcar idling beside cobblestones on the far right
